title: A line created before this change reaches the report in the new form
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Require Tech Story (Settings, Work Orders tab) is off.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15102) for customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-A11 Fleet) was created before this change reached the build, with a contact person and a labor line {Line-1} that has a title (for example "Replace tie rod") and a description (for example "excessive play") but no tech story.
  • {Work-order-1} has now been completed and invoiced as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  3. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  4. Download the report.
  5. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  6. Find the row for {Line-1} on invoice {Invoice-A} and read its ItemDescription cell.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: the cell reads {Line-1}'s title, " - ", then its description (with the example values "Replace tie rod - excessive play").
  • Step 6: no old labels or questions appear: no "What are you doing?:", no "Why are you doing it?:" and no "Tech Story:".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-N2, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (What reaches QuickBooks), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-008; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N2: “No line falls back to the old labels or the old questions, including lines created before this change.”
  • Tech plan FR-008: “Labor line text is `{Title} - {Description} - {Tech story}`: no labels, no semicolons, separator exactly `" - "`, only between two present segments, no trailing separator or space; no line falls back to old labels (S3-R1, S3-R2, S3-R3, S3-R5, S3-E1, S3-N2).”
